IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 latency breach on streaming-prod (model=rw-v2-int8) — auto-escalation to oncall-sre.
Lena M.: seeing huge tail latencies, p99 ~ 2.1s, usual ~600ms. p95 also elevated.
Kai W.: any recent config rollouts? Calib profile change earlier this morning.
Ravi S.: yep we pushed quant-profile v3 -> int8-calib:adaptive at 09:04 UTC. Canary looked fine.
Lena M.: streaming stalls reported. Clients seeing mid-stream stalls (tokens stop for 2–5s then continue).
Alex P.: logs show many requests stuck on KV cache wait in runtime threadpool. attaching sample:
```
[2026-03-15T09:28:12Z] req=0x7fd3a1 token_stream stalled at kv_cache_fetch (wait_spin=120ms)
[2026-03-15T09:28:12Z] kernel=quant_int8_run: acquired mutex timeout after 1024ms
[2026-03-15T09:28:12Z] falling back to fp compute path triggered=1
```
Tess R.: that kernel mutex thing looks new — could be different locking pattern introduced by the int8 calibration change.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. Rolling investigation. Can we get traffic routing snapshot?
Lena M.: routing shows 35% of streaming traffic routed to cluster-gamma (where int8-calib was enabled), 65% to cluster-alpha (fp fallback).
Kai W.: if cluster-gamma is hitting a lock/unblock loop we should route all streaming to cluster-alpha as mitigation.
Ravi S.: agree. Initiating emergency route override to force fp variants for streaming endpoints. Command: `routerctl set-route streaming-prod --force-variant=fp32 --reason="int8-kernel-locks"`
Alex P.: also recommend disabling adaptive-calib autosave so no further on-the-fly profile changes. `calibctl disable-autosave rw-v2-int8`
Tess R.: customer impact: initial estimate 8% of streaming sessions experienced an interruption >1s in last 10m, mainly on EU region. Some retries recovered. No data loss.
Lena M.: marking incident Sev2 -> potential customer-visible degradation. Notify support.
IncidentBot: SupportAlert created: #support-ops, ticket #INC-14288, message sent to CSM roster.
oncall-sre: override applied. Routing now stabilizing. p99 starting to drop back.
Kai W.: still seeing occasional kernel timeouts in gamma logs. Suggest we hotpatch runtime to increase spin threshold and add per-request backoff.
Ravi S.: hotpatch plan: push hotfix that changes kernel mutex spin->exponential backoff and forces early fallback to fp path after 400ms. Small binary bump non-invasive. Rollout to gamma canary then to gamma-all if green.
Alex P.: prepping canary. Canary route to 3 nodes in gamma.
Lena M.: meanwhile, enable streaming short-circuit fallback so if stall >500ms we stream partial and close kv op. Config: `streamctl set short_circuit_timeout 500ms`
Tess R.: letting CSM know that we applied route override and are rolling hotfix; estimated recovery 20–30m.
Kai W.: note: calibration autosave caused profiles to persist after we rolled out; we need rollback of profile v3 in modelstore to avoid re-applying later. `modelstore rollback-profile rw-v2-int8 v2`
Ravi S.: rolling profile rollback now.
Alex P.: can we capture a representative heap and futex stacks from a stuck thread? grabbing with `gcore` and `pstack` now.
Lena M.: good, post traces into /incidents/attachments.
IncidentBot: Metric snapshot attached — p95: 1.0s -> 1.3s, p99: 600ms -> 2.1s at peak, streaming_error_rate: +0.9pp.
oncall-sre: hotfix canary deployed to gamma-canary. Observability: kernel mutex timeouts drop by 80% on canary nodes.
Kai W.: canary looks good. Plan: roll gamma 25% -> 50% -> 100% over next 15m with health checks.
Tess R.: updated support with templated message for affected customers: short form, root cause suspected quantization calibration profile causing contention in kernel locks leading to streaming stalls, mitigation applied (forced fp32), hotfix rolling, ETA 25m.
Lena M.: after roll complete, run synthetic streaming workload to confirm tail recovery.
Ravi S.: roll started. Monitoring p99 and stall counts.
Alex P.: post-mortem notes to capture: why canary calibs passed earlier, why autosave policy allowed a bad profile to propagate, and add unit test to simulate kernel-level contention with int8 path.
Lena M.: agreed. After-action: 1) block autosave until additional vetting, 2) add backoff in kernel, 3) add streaming short-circuit as an automatic SLO safeguard, 4) improve canary traffic mix to include long-context streaming.
Tess R.: I'll schedule follow-up with CSM and affected customers after final verification.
oncall-sre: roll at 100% complete. p99 back down to 630ms, p95 580ms. Error rate normalizing.
Lena M.: closing the page. Creating incident ticket INC-14288 with links to logs, traces, and rollback steps.
IncidentBot: Incident state -> mitigated. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems/ within 72h. :white_check_mark:
Kai W.: thumbs for everyone who jumped in. :thumbsup:
Ravi S.: will draft postmortem and include repro harness.
Alex P.: saved kernel traces and gcore dump at S3://redwood-incidents/4471209999/
Tess R.: confirmed support notified and customers updated.
Lena M.: oncall handoff to Kai at 10:00 UTC; leaving notes in the channel.
Kai W.: taking oncall. Thanks all.
